name: Kazipur

requestOutcomes.outcome: Reached the official Ministry of Land map viewer; retrieved current HTML, CSRF token, and JavaScript configuration.
Inspected current JS. It identifies public POST routes /getAdminByCode, /GetCascadeGeom, /getGeomByCode and /GetPlotInfo; WKT is parsed as EPSG:4326 data.
Division list returned Rajshahi; attempts to enumerate Sirajganj/Kazipur through the dropdown route returned empty arrays, so no fabricated code or parcel query was made.
At the exact WUP point, forDiv/forDist/forThana returned administrative WKT. The forThana response included district Sirajganj, thana Kazipur and union labels including Chalitadanga.
Exact-point forMauza request returned the site's generic Server Error HTML; this is a route failure, not evidence of no parcels.
Exact-point forPlot request returned an empty JSON array; no parcel identity or geometry was retained and this is not evidence of citywide absence.
Official DLRS online land record/survey system identified; no login or unsafe record lookup was attempted.
Official DLRS map purchase service identified; no purchase, owner/title lookup, or unsafe field request was attempted.
Official Kazipur Upazila portal confirms local administrative context; no parcel endpoint was evidenced there.
